newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-KRAJICEK BEAT RAOUX TO TAKE ROSMALEN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KRAJICEK BEAT RAOUX TO TAKE ROSMALEN TITLE.

text.p: Richard Krajicek completed an ideal warm-up for his Wimbledon title when he won the Heineken Trophy grass-court final in convincing style on Sunday.

Less than 24 hours before the start of Wimbledon, the third-seeded Dutchman scored a 6-4 7-6 victory in 68 minutes over French qualifier Guillaume Raoux 6-4 7-6, the second time he has won this tournament in seven appearances.
Krajicek, in excellent form in the week before Wimbledon, broke Raoux once in the first set but neither player managed a service break in the second, forcing a tie-break which the Dutchman won 9-7.
Krajicek hit 14 aces in the final and did lost a single service game throughout the tournament.
He is seeded fourth at Wimbledon and will move from sixth to the fifth in the ATP world rankings on Monday.
